newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Public Service Q2 share fall.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Public Service Q2 share fall.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers) NOTE: In a statement, Enterprise said its results were comparatively lower for several key reasons including:

* Earnings per share in the second quarter of 1996 reflected a one-time, seven-cent gain from the repurchase of a portion of seven series of Public Service Electric and Gas Company's (PSE&G) outstanding cumulative preferred stock at discounts to par through a tender offer.

* Electric sales by PSE&G were lower due to considerably cooler weather during the 1997 period, which affected air conditioning use, particularly by residential customers. This had a net negative impact on overall electric and gas sales of about 3 cents per share.
* Higher administrative costs in the quarter, amounting to about 4 cents per share, primarily attributable to issues related to the outage of the Salem Generating Station.
* Startup costs, amounting to about 2 cents per share, incurred by Energis Resources, Enterprise's energy management company established in January of this year.
